cards.title: None
cards.description: The class is for people with no special abilities or combat training. They can’t use any special techniques. They are just ordinary humans relying on their own strength, speed, and cleverness to survive.

cards.title: Colors Trap
cards.description: A Colors Trap Artist is a fighter who uses special paint to control people’s emotions. By drawing small symbols in different colors, they can make enemies laugh, cry, calm down, or even turn on their own crew. The colors work like tricks on the mind, so the artist doesn’t need strength or weapons. Their power comes from their brush, their paint, and how fast they can draw.

cards.title: Art of Weather
cards.description: With the Art of Weather, the user becomes a master of the sky, sea and storms. They wield a specialized weather‑staff and combine knowledge of winds, temperature, clouds and storms to manipulate the battlefield. They can summon gusts, clouds, lightning or rain to turn the tide of combat, using both cunning and power. (Would recommend choosing the Normal, Perfect or Sorcery Clima‑Tact weapon if you’re going for this class!)

cards.title: Observation Haki
cards.description: Observation Haki is the power to sense what is happening around you, even if you cannot see it. It lets you feel the presence, strength, and emotions of others. With this, you can read movements, dodge attacks, and notice danger before it happens. It is like having a sharper awareness of everything nearby, helping you react faster in battle.

cards.title: Full Haki User
cards.description: A warrior who has transcended normal combat by mastering the spiritual force known as Haki. They wield Observation Haki to sense opponents and incoming danger, Armament Haki to harden their body and attacks beyond steel, and Conqueror’s Haki to exert their will over the weak-minded and clash with the world’s strongest. A Haki Master is very good with haki and their power lies in pure will, sharpened instinct, and unshakable spirit.

cards.title: Armament Haki
cards.description: Armament Haki allows the user to surround themselves or a weapon with their own spiritual energy, effectively creating an invisible armor that boosts defense and offensive power. It also lets them touch or damage opponents who are normally immune, like those with certain Devil Fruit powers.

cards.title: Supreme King Haki
cards.description: Supreme King Haki is the power to overpower others using pure will. When someone uses it, a strong pressure spreads out from them. People with weak spirits can freeze up, become scared, or fall unconscious without being touched. It can affect many people at once and shows who has the stronger will. Only very rare individuals are born with this power.

cards.title: Okama Kenpo
cards.description: Okama Kenpo is a flashy fighting style that mixes dance-like moves with strong kicks. It focuses on speed, flexibility, and surprising opponents. By moving in unusual ways, the fighter can attack and dodge at the same time, keeping enemies off balance.

cards.title: Life Return
cards.description: Life Return lets a person control their body very carefully. They can make their muscles, bones, and movements stronger, faster, and more flexible. This control helps them move quickly, recover from injuries, and perform amazing tricks in battle.

cards.title: Honestly Impact
cards.description: Honestly Impact is a fighting style that uses hard, accurate punches. Each hit is meant to do the most damage, break an opponent’s guard, or stop several attackers at once. It focuses on strong muscles and quick reactions, so it works well in face-to-face fights while staying controlled and precise.

cards.title: Lily Carnation
cards.description: The Lily Carnation Wielder has formed a symbiotic bond with the legendary Lily Carnation, a monstrous plant capable of controlling life and reanimating the dead. This connection allows the wielder to manipulate life forces, summon reanimated beings, and wield plant-based constructs in combat. While powerful, the bond is a curse as the plant’s insatiable hunger for life constantly threatens the wielder.

cards.title: Six Powers
cards.description: A powerful martial arts style known as the Six Powers used by elite fighters. It grants superhuman speed, strength, and agility through techniques like Iron Body, Moon Walk, and Tempest Kick, making the user extremely versatile in combat.

cards.title: Foxfire Style
cards.description: oxfire Style is a swordsmanship technique that lets the user generate and control fire through their sword. Attacks are stronger and can burn or cut through enemies with heat. The fire can also be used defensively, creating barriers or protecting the user. Practitioners move with precision and power, combining sword skill and flames for deadly combat.

cards.title: Black Leg Style
cards.description: Black Leg Style focuses on strong, fast, and acrobatic kicks. The fighter can heat up their legs, adding fire to every strike for extra damage. Skilled users combine speed, jumping attacks, and spinning kicks to hit enemies from different angles. They are hard to predict and can fight multiple enemies at once, using blazing kicks to control the battlefield and overwhelm opponents.

cards.title: Fish Man Jujutsu
cards.description: Fish-Man Jujutsu is for close fighting. Practitioners grab, throw, and lock enemies using their strength and the opponent’s momentum. Water makes their moves smooth and fast, adding extra power. Masters can control fights with clever holds and throws, taking down bigger or stronger opponents with skill rather than raw power.

cards.title: Eight Impacts Fist
cards.description: Eight Impact Fist allows the user to control body vibrations, creating powerful shockwaves with each strike. These reverberating attacks bypass defenses, making them unblockable and capable of shattering even the toughest armor.

cards.title: Dragon Claw Fist
cards.description: The Dragon Claw Fist is a formidable martial art that transforms the user's hands into claw-like weapons, channeling the ferocity of a dragon. Enhanced with Armament Haki, each strike delivers crushing force, capable of shattering steel and overwhelming foes with fiery precision.

cards.title: Hypnotist
cards.description: Hypnotists are masters of the mind, using subtle cues, gestures, and voice to control, confuse, or influence others. They can manipulate emotions, induce sleep, or bend enemies to their will. Skilled Hypnotists excel in strategy and deception, turning the battlefield in their favor without needing raw strength.

cards.title: Galaxy Impact
cards.description: Warriors of cosmic might, Galaxy Impact fighters harness the power of stars and celestial energy to unleash devastating attacks. Known for their explosive combat style, they combine incredible physical strength with energy manipulation that can devastate large areas, making them formidable both on land and at sea!

cards.title: Soul Damage Haki
cards.description: A rare and advanced form of Haki that lets the user damage an opponent’s soul, bypassing physical defenses. It inflicts deep mental and spiritual harm, weakening resolve and disrupting focus. Mastery of this Haki demands immense spiritual strength and control, making it one of the most formidable abilities.

cards.title: Voice of All Things
cards.description: A rare ability to hear the mysterious voices of the world animals, nature, and ancient relics. Masters use this to sense danger, communicate beyond words, and uncover hidden secrets others cannot perceive.

cards.title: Awakened Devil Fruit
cards.description: An Awakened Devil Fruit is a rare and advanced state where a user has fully mastered their fruit's power, allowing them to affect the environment or their own body in extraordinary ways. This stage greatly enhances their abilities, durability, and control, making them a serious threat even to top-tier fighters.

cards.title: Will of D.
cards.description: Carriers of a mysterious legacy, those with the D. in their name possess an unyielding spirit, fearless courage, and a fate intertwined with great change. They inspire allies and defy even the strongest enemies through sheer willpower.

cards.title: Poneglyphs Reader
cards.description: A scholar who deciphers the ancient, indestructible stones that reveal lost history, secrets of the Void Century, and hidden locations. Their knowledge can unlock powerful truths and guide daring adventures.

cards.title: Treasure Hunter
cards.description: Experts in finding hidden loot, deciphering maps, and avoiding traps.

cards.title: Blacksmith
cards.description: Crafts weapons and armor with unique materials from the Grand Line.

cards.title: Musician
cards.description: Empowers teammates or confuses enemies with rhythm-based support techniques.

cards.title: Professional Cook
cards.description: A master chef who heals and boosts allies with powerful meals. Skilled in both cooking and combat, they keep their crew or strong and ready for any adventure.

cards.title: Gadgeteer
cards.description: Uses custom-built gadgets, smoke bombs, traps, and mechanical tools in combat.

cards.title: Sniper
cards.description: Long-range marksman specializing in rifles, pistols, or trick shot weapons like slingshots.

cards.title: Tactician
cards.description: Battlefield controller who can command allies, predict enemy moves, and exploit weak points.

cards.title: Weapon Master
cards.description: Trained in using multiple weapons (axes, chains, fans, etc.) with expert precision.

cards.title: Spear Fighter
cards.description: Polearm users with long-range melee techniques and spinning crowd control moves.

cards.title: Brawler
cards.description: Raw strength-based fighters who use brute force, grapples, and wrestling moves.

cards.title: Martial Artist
cards.description: Hand-to-hand fighters specializing in styles like Fish-Man Karate, Black Leg, or Rokushiki.

cards.title: Beast Tamer
cards.description: Commands and communicates with sea beasts, land animals, or mythical Zoans.

cards.title: Tailor
cards.description: Uses clothing and thread for offense and defense. May create disguises, armor, or even thread-based traps.

cards.title: Archaeologist
cards.description: Masters of ancient texts, Poneglyphs, and lost knowledge. May uncover secrets that lead to ancient weapons or mythical lore.

cards.title: Shipwright
cards.description: Craft specialists who can repair and build ships mid-battle, as well as develop ship-based weapons.

cards.title: Navigator
cards.description: Experts in ocean travel, weather prediction, and map-making. Can control ship-based combat or affect environmental hazards.

cards.title: Doctor
cards.description: Vital support class focused on healing, antidotes, and enhancing crew performance with medicine or stimulants.

cards.title: Cyborg
cards.description: Tech-savvy inventors who modify their own bodies or build powerful tools and weapons. Often mix science with combat.

cards.title: Gunslinger
cards.description: Long-range fighters with pinpoint accuracy. Masters of firearms, trick shots, and explosive ordinance.

cards.title: Swordsman
cards.description: Masters of swordsmanship who can use advanced techniques like flying slashes and elemental-style swordplay.
